scope: ObfuscationOS refactor/ext4-layout (084e2bf) against the kernel-sdk export of 5372e50: CI fast-lane steps, artifact tests, the ext4 two-boot persistence test and the native ext4 units.
claims: kernel-sdk-check, uapi-test, libc-test, distro_image, linux-driver-compat, rootfs-simplefs, rootfs-ext4 and qemu-distro --require-native pass on x86_64, arm32 and ppc; compat-test passes on x86_64

artifact tests on x86_64: the xmake artifact-test run (1287 tests) reports the same two errors as the 658b18b run, both an `xmake f` subprocess exceeding its 90 s timeout on a loaded host; test_native_metadata_wrappers and test_native_pty_wrappers pass alone on both trees, and the run in two processes (all modules, then test_native_child_exit_lineage_guest, which crashed the shared CPython interpreter in earlier runs on both trees) passes 1287 of 1287
the ext4 two-boot persistence test passes; its offline content is byte-identical to the 658b18b + 7ddd8bb SDK run
the ext4 tests/native units that compile standalone produce the same code against the 7ddd8bb and 5372e50 SDKs (byte-identical objects, per-symbol -O2 assembly, or per-symbol -O0 assembly)
